title: Credit Builder Accounts Due Day on AutoPay Re-Enrollment
content:
When AutoPay is turned on again on a Credit Builder Accounts account whose AutoPay debit was returned, the due day stays the account's current due day.

## Rules on the due day and the next due date

1. A Credit Builder due day is never later than day 28.
2. When the due day comes out where it already is, the due day is not changed: AutoPay is turned on with the current due day and the current next due date, and no due date moves.
3. When the account shows an amount past due, the due day is not changed: AutoPay is turned on with the current due day and the next due date stays the oldest unpaid due date, so no unpaid installment is moved later.

The current due day and the next due date (the oldest unpaid due date) are shown on the account record, and so is the amount past due.

| Account record | Due day taken | Next due date taken |
|---|---|---|
| due day 9, next due date 9 August, nothing past due | 9 | 9 August |
| due day 9, next due date 9 July, amount past due 60.00 | 9 | 9 July, the oldest unpaid due date |

The examples use hypothetical dates and amounts.
